reason: The motor needs a stable place on the base; this is the only offered action.
expectation: I expect the motor to be mounted on the wave-machine base, ready for the drive parts.

effect: The motor is mounted, ready for a drive connection.
reaction: A straightforward start; nothing surprising yet.
reason: The eccentric driver is the only offered combination and should help turn rotation into a wiggle.
expectation: I expect the driver to be mounted on the frame, though it may need a belt before it moves.

effect: The off-centre peg will move the cord's end as it circles, explaining how the driver can create a disturbance.
reaction: The moving peg makes the mechanism clearer.
reason: The belt is the only offered combination and should connect the motor to the driver.
expectation: I expect the belt to link the motor and eccentric driver, though the machine may still need power and a cord.

effect: The belt drive is in place, ready for the cord.
reason: The cord is the only offered combination and is needed to show the wiggle.
expectation: I expect the cord to be attached to the driver and anchored at the far end, though it may still need tensioning.

effect: The cord is fitted but loose, so it needs tensioning.
reaction: The loose cord makes the next step clear.
reason: The tension spring is the only offered combination and should make the cord taut enough to show a wave.
expectation: I expect the spring to tension the cord; the machine may still need power and its guard.

effect: The cord is now tensioned, ready for the remaining drive setup.
reason: The guard is the only offered combination and should cover the moving drive parts.
expectation: I expect the guard to fit over the belt and driver; the machine may still need power.

effect: The guard covers the drive while leaving its motion visible, and the motor is still disconnected.
reaction: Seeing the drive path through a safety cover is a useful detail.
reason: The battery and controller are the only offered combination and should power the machine.
expectation: I expect the motor to turn the guarded drive and send a visible wiggle along the cord, possibly with adjustable speed.

effect: The powered peg sends a disturbance along the cord, which reflects at the far end; the chapter goal is complete.
reaction: The reflected wiggle is an interesting payoff after the straightforward assembly.

mostWorthwhile.text: Powering the machine was most worthwhile: it showed the assembled parts producing a travelling and reflected disturbance.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the belt and tensioning the cord were useful but felt like routine assembly, with no meaningful choice between combinations.

surprise.text: The disturbance reflecting from the far end added something I had not expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though each decision offered only one combination, so I was following the available sequence rather than figuring out compatibility.

continue.text: I might continue for another mechanism: the visible drive path and reflected wiggle were interesting, although I would hope for more meaningful choices.
